title: 第24章 夏蓝曦犯病第25章 混入寢宫
content_zh:
夏蓝曦准备的晚膳非常丰富，而且食材之高档，用料之丰富，完全超乎楚夏的预料。
这么说吧。
楚夏原以为是珍饈美味的莽兽肉，在这里根本上不了台面。
各种妖兽的肉这里应有尽有。
甚至有一道菜是用蛟龙心肝来做的。
蛟龙可是大乾皇朝境內最顶级的妖兽，一旦出现，需要出动上万人的军队去剿灭。
楚夏的父亲当年就率领神武军，去剿灭过一处蛟龙巢穴，屠戮了四条大蛟。
那是一场血战。
可如今，蛟龙的內臟却变成食材，出现在的餐桌上。
难道这才是真正的皇家子弟的奢华做派嘛？
那长公主算什么？
紫月殿的伙食，连妖兽肉很极少出现，更別说蛟龙肉了。
“夏初大师，请用膳吧。”
夏蓝曦看著楚夏说道，对他面具下的真容还是充满好奇的。
之前不好开口，可现在都吃饭了，你总不能还一直把面具戴著吧。
她很想看看，被夏紫萱看中的男人，究竟长什么模样。
“好。”
面具落下，一张普普通通，平平无奇的脸出现在夏蓝曦面前。
看清夏初『真容』的瞬间，夏蓝曦心头略微有些意外。
虽然她预期的不太一样，不过也没有让她太失望。

就是很普通的长相，说不上帅，但也绝对不丑，倒是气质方面要更加出类拔萃一些，沉稳而不失张力，给人的第一感觉就很可靠，值得信赖。
而且才能是可以弥补外貌的。
炼药宗师和剑道高手的身份，足以给夏初加分不少。
“对了，有菜岂能无酒，小然，把我珍藏的药酒取一壶来。”夏蓝曦吩咐道。
“六殿下，待会还要炼製丹药，还是別喝酒了吧。”
“小酌怡情，不碍事的。”
夏蓝曦大大方方的说道。
“那行吧。”
楚夏勉为其难的点了点头。
有万神鼎在，他倒是不怕夏蓝曦会在酒里下毒。
经过涤尘丹洗髓伐毛，他的体质也远超普通武者，夏蓝曦如果是想把他灌醉了套话，那就更不可能了。
先静观其变，看看她究竟有什么打算。
content_en:
The dinner prepared by Xia Lanxi was very rich, and the ingredients were high-end and rich, completely beyond Chu Xia's expectations.
Put it this way.
Chu Xia originally thought that the meat of wild beasts was a delicacy, but it was simply not on the table here.
All kinds of monster meat are available here.
There is even a dish made with dragon heart and liver.
The dragon is the top monster in the Daqian Dynasty. Once it appears, tens of thousands of troops need to be dispatched to destroy it.
Back then, Chu Xia's father led the Shenwu Army to destroy a dragon nest and slaughtered four giant dragons.
It was a bloody battle.
But now, the dragon's internal organs have become food and appear on the dining table.
Is this the true luxury style of a royal child?
What is the eldest princess?
The food in Ziyue Palace rarely even contains monster meat, let alone dragon meat.
"Master Xia Chu, please have a meal."
Xia Lanxi looked at Chu Xia and said, still curious about his true appearance under the mask.
It was hard to speak before, but now it's time to eat, so you can't keep wearing the mask.
She really wanted to see what the man Xia Zixuan was attracted to looked like.
"Okay."
The mask fell down, and an ordinary, unremarkable face appeared in front of Xia Lanxi.
The moment she saw Xia Chu's "true face" clearly, Xia Lanxi felt a little surprised.
Although it was different from what she expected, it didn't disappoint her too much.
He has a very ordinary appearance. He cannot be said to be handsome, but he is definitely not ugly. However, his temperament is more outstanding. He is calm without losing tension. The first impression he gives is that he is reliable and trustworthy.
And talent can make up for appearance.
Being a master of alchemy and a master of swordsmanship is enough to give Xia Chu a lot of points.
"By the way, how can you have food without wine? Xiaoran, bring me a pot of medicinal wine that I have collected." Xia Lanxi ordered.
"Your Highness, Sixth Highness, we have to refine the elixir later, so it's better not to drink."
"It's okay to have a drink and enjoy yourself."
Xia Lanxi said openly.
"That's okay."
Chu Xia reluctantly nodded.
With the Ten Thousand God Cauldron here, he was not afraid that Xia Lanxi would poison the wine.
After cleansing his marrow and removing his hair with the Cleansing Pill, his physique was far superior to that of an ordinary warrior. If Xia Lanxi wanted to get him drunk and talk nonsense, it would be even more impossible.
Let's wait and see what happens and see what she has planned.
